title: Prasi leaf drawing
summary: Scratch a little sea story into a strip of palm leaf with a fine point: a sun, a palm, a sailing boat, waves and a leaping fish. Then rub in soot to make the lines dark.
howToPlay: The framed leaf shows the finished drawing.
Press and drag the point along each lit line; the scratches are pale at first.
Press Rub soot when every line is drawn.
rules: Score: how closely your lines follow the guide, and a penalty for stray scratches.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn plays a whole round for you, and Undo takes back the last step.
heritageNote: Prasi is a Balinese art of drawing or carving narrative scenes on lontar, dried palm leaf. The lines are cut with a fine point, then soot mixed with oil is rubbed in and wiped off, so the picture stays dark only in the scratches.
